revision_note: The Meta binary distribution has S3 object versions, not Git model revisions. Full object versions and SHA256 pin the source content. Loader commit is separate. These are release reproduction pins checked against A, not a guessed historical Git revision.

fingerprint_rule.scope: All EsmModel state_dict entries plus registered named buffers, including nonpersistent position IDs; no omitted runtime parameters
fingerprint_rule.header: UTF-8 JSON: name,dtype,shape; sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=True
fingerprint_rule.framing: SHA256 begins bytes IL24-ESM2-TENSORS-v1 followed by NUL. Per tensor: 8-byte big-endian header length, header, 8-byte big-endian byte length, C-contiguous original-dtype CPU bytes in little endian. No dtype casts.
fingerprint_rule.shared_parameters: Every named alias is included separately; actual A has no shared-storage groups; verify alias groups too
fingerprint_rule.configuration: Canonical loaded config.to_dict excluding only _name_or_path; tokenizer vocab/special tokens/IDs/length/padding/truncation/input names; SHA256 canonical JSON

verification_policy: Downloaded official files compare with source SHA256. Converted models compare with independent frozen A tensor/config/tokenizer fingerprints.
